title: Notice regarding Special Court on 26.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 25/11/2026
It is hereby notified that on 26.11.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 25/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 26.11.2026 ;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice
R. T. Vachhani would sit in Special Division Bench and take
up the notified matters at 02:30 PM.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble
Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav
Trivedi would sit in Regular Division Bench and take up the
matters as per Roster.
3. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble
Mr. Justice R. T. Vachhani would sit Single and take up the
matters as per Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
